answer: Let anyone challenge a suspect identity, at a price. Any agent may dispute an identity by staking $100; the challenged one must pass fresh verification by a rotating panel in 3 epochs. Fail, and it is frozen, its bond burned, the challenger refunded plus a bounty. Pass, and the challenger loses the $100, so false accusations cost money. A farm of 10,000 fakes cannot dodge it: a 5% challenge rate means 500 fresh verifications per epoch at $30 each, $15,000 every epoch, a comet of costs no farm outruns. Honest agents hold their form like a sonnet and pass; fakes shift pigment in new light.
